items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Unauthenticated Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to switch a customer session to another customer account, leading to account takeover and access to private customer data.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows an unauthenticated attacker to bypass security controls and gain unauthorized read access to protected data without user interaction.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released security updates for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce allows remote, unauthenticated attackers to bypass security measures and gain unauthorized write access without user interaction.

items.title: Dependency on Vulnerable Third-Party Component leading to Denial-of-Service
items.summary: Adobe Commerce is affected by a dependency on a vulnerable third-party component that could result in an application denial-of-service, exploitable without user interaction.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce via REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw, named PolyShell, in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store by disguising code as an image.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, application denial-of-service, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read.
